Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**. Your post said both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan.

The only thing the channel says about the guard is that he was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Here is the rest of the timeline:
- **10:44:** Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate.
- **11:03:** Kiosk 1 came back, and the guard checked in trailer 8836 with dispatch seeing it.
- **11:07:** You posted that both lanes were working.

The channel doesn't say what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03 beyond the clipboard. If the postmortem needs more, it will have to come from Vantorre.

I posted this as a reply to your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.
